titleEn: Optimization basics: turning “better” into a checkable objective
title:
优化基础：把“更好”写成可检查的目标

Optimization basics: turning “better” into a checkable objective

blocks.text: 运动规划、标定、轨迹平滑、视觉估计和强化学习都在反复回答同一个问题：在约束下，怎样选择一个更好的变量？优化的重点不是背下某个算法名称，而是把变量、目标、约束、尺度和停止条件写清楚。本章从一维直觉开始，逐步连接到最小二乘、梯度下降、约束和机器人轨迹。

Motion planning, calibration, trajectory smoothing, visual estimation, and reinforcement learning repeatedly ask the same question: how should a variable be chosen to improve an objective under constraints? The important skill is not memorizing algorithm names. It is specifying variables, objectives, constraints, scales, and stopping conditions. We begin with one-dimensional intuition and connect it to least squares, gradient descent, constraints, and robot trajectories.
8.1 变量、目标与约束 8.1 Variables, objectives, and constraints
一个优化问题至少有三层：变量 $x$ 是要决定的东西；目标 $J(x)$ 是怎样衡量好坏；约束 $g(x)\le0$ 或 $h(x)=0$ 是不能违反的条件。例如关节轨迹可以用离散点 $q_0,\ldots,q_N$ 表示，目标可以惩罚末端误差、速度变化和能量，约束则包括关节范围、速度上限和碰撞距离。

An optimization problem has at least three layers: variables $x$ are what we choose; an objective $J(x)$ measures quality; constraints $g(x)\le0$ or $h(x)=0$ encode what cannot be violated. A discretized joint trajectory may contain $q_0,\ldots,q_N$. Its objective can penalize end-effector error, velocity changes, and energy, while constraints enforce joint limits, speed limits, and collision clearance.
“最小化位置误差”不是完整任务。必须进一步问：误差在哪个坐标系？平移和旋转怎样加权？碰撞是硬约束还是惩罚项？目标达到什么阈值才算成功？这些问题决定了优化器看到的地形，也决定了结果是否能被另一个人复现。

“Minimize position error” is not a complete task specification. In which frame is the error measured? How are translation and rotation weighted? Is collision a hard constraint or a penalty? What threshold counts as success? These decisions define the landscape seen by the optimizer and determine whether another researcher can reproduce the result.
8.2 梯度：局部地形的方向 8.2 The gradient as a local direction
一维函数的导数告诉我们向右走时函数会上升还是下降；多变量函数的梯度 $\nabla J(x)$ 收集了每个方向的变化率。小步近似为
令 $\Delta x=-\alpha\nabla J(x)$ 就得到梯度下降。它只保证在足够小的步长和局部条件下有下降趋势，并不保证找到全局最优。

For a one-dimensional function, the derivative says whether moving right increases or decreases the function. In multiple dimensions, the gradient $\nabla J(x)$ collects directional rates of change. A local approximation is
Choosing $\Delta x=-\alpha\nabla J(x)$ gives gradient descent. It tends to decrease the objective only under local conditions and a suitable step size; it does not guarantee a global optimum.

blocks.title: 从导数到机器人：有限差分是桥梁 From derivatives to robots: finite differences are a bridge

blocks.text: 当你还不能可靠地推导复杂目标的梯度时，可以先用有限差分检查方向：$\partial_iJ\approx[J(x+he_i)-J(x-he_i)]/(2h)$。有限差分不是最终的高效实现，但它能验证雅可比、代价函数和自动微分是否符号一致。

When an analytic gradient is not yet trustworthy, use finite differences to check the direction: $\partial_iJ\approx[J(x+he_i)-J(x-he_i)]/(2h)$. Finite differences are not the final efficient implementation, but they are an excellent check for Jacobians, cost functions, and automatic differentiation.
8.3 最小二乘与标定 8.3 Least squares and calibration
许多机器人问题可以写成“让残差尽量小”：$\min_\theta\|A\theta-b\|_2^2$。标定相机外参、估计关节零偏、拟合传感器偏置和学习简单动力学参数都常见这种形式。正规方程 $A^\mathsf{T}A\theta=A^\mathsf{T}b$ 有助于理解，但工程实现通常使用 QR 或 SVD，避免显式计算可能病态的 $A^\mathsf{T}A$。

Many robotics problems can be written as making residuals small: $\min_\theta\|A\theta-b\|_2^2$. This appears in camera calibration, joint zero-offset estimation, sensor bias fitting, and simple dynamics identification. The normal equation $A^\mathsf{T}A\theta=A^\mathsf{T}b$ is useful for intuition, but engineering code usually uses QR or SVD instead of explicitly forming a potentially ill-conditioned $A^\mathsf{T}A$.

blocks.code:
def fit_line(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float).reshape(-1)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float).reshape(-1)
    if x.shape != y.shape or x.size < 2:
        raise ValueError("need paired samples")
    A = np.column_stack([x, np.ones_like(x)])
    theta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, y, rcond=None)  # SVD/QR-backed
    residual = A @ theta - y
    return theta, float(np.linalg.norm(residual))

x = np.linspace(-1, 1, 20)
y = 2.0 * x + 0.3 + 0.03 * np.sin(7 * x)
theta, residual_norm = fit_line(x, y)
assert np.allclose(theta, [2.0, 0.3], atol=0.05)

blocks.text: 残差范数不是唯一证据。要同时观察参数是否具有物理意义、残差是否随样本分布变化、矩阵是否病态以及未参与拟合的数据是否也能预测。一个只在某个姿态附近表现好的标定模型，不能直接外推到装配工作空间。

The residual norm is not the only evidence. Check whether parameters are physically meaningful, whether residuals change across the sample distribution, whether the matrix is ill-conditioned, and whether held-out samples are predicted well. A calibration model that works near one pose should not be extrapolated blindly to the whole assembly workspace.
8.4 约束、惩罚与投影 8.4 Constraints, penalties, and projection
如果变量必须满足 $l\le x\le u$，最简单的方法是在每次更新后投影：$x\leftarrow\min(\max(x,l),u)$。对于更复杂的约束，可以把违反程度加入目标，例如 $J_{pen}=J+\lambda\max(0,g(x))^2$。投影更像“绝不允许越界”，惩罚更像“越界很贵”；两者都需要检查尺度和权重。

If a variable must satisfy $l\le x\le u$, the simplest method is projection after each update: $x\leftarrow\min(\max(x,l),u)$. For more complex constraints, add violation to the objective, for example $J_{pen}=J+\lambda\max(0,g(x))^2$. Projection means “never leave the set”; a penalty means “leaving is expensive.” Both require careful scaling and weight checks.

blocks.code:
def projected_step(x, grad, step, lower, upper):
    candidate = np.asarray(x) - step * np.asarray(grad)
    return np.minimum(np.maximum(candidate, lower), upper)

q = np.array([2.8, -2.4])
qmin = np.array([-1.0, -1.0])
qmax = np.array([1.0, 1.0])
q_next = projected_step(q, np.array([0.2, -0.4]), 0.5, qmin, qmax)
assert np.all(q_next >= qmin) and np.all(q_next <= qmax)

blocks.text: 8.5 轨迹代价与数值尺度 8.5 Trajectory costs and numerical scale
轨迹优化通常把多个物理意图相加：
权重不是“调到看起来好看”为止。应先把每项变成无量纲或可比较的范围，再通过消融实验报告去掉某一项会发生什么。否则读者无法判断改进来自算法还是权重。
Trajectory optimization often combines several physical intentions:

Weights should not be tuned only until a plot looks good. Normalize terms to comparable, dimensionless ranges, then report ablations showing what happens when each term is removed. Otherwise it is impossible to tell whether an improvement came from the algorithm or from the weights.

blocks.title: 优化失败的三个信号 Three signals of optimization failure

blocks.text: 第一，目标下降但任务指标变差，说明代价函数和任务成功条件脱节；第二，不同随机种子得到完全不同的方案，说明局部极小、尺度或探索不足；第三，训练曲线很平滑但仿真或真实系统失败，说明模型、坐标、碰撞几何或执行器约束不一致。每个信号都需要回到定义、单位、数据和约束，而不是立即换一个优化器。

First, the objective decreases while task success worsens: the cost is misaligned with the task. Second, different seeds produce very different solutions: local minima, scaling, or insufficient exploration may dominate. Third, the training curve is smooth but simulation or hardware fails: models, frames, collision geometry, or actuator limits disagree. Return to definitions, units, data, and constraints before changing the optimizer.
8.6 本章总结与研究出口 8.6 Chapter recap and research exit
优化是一种建模语言：把“更快、更稳、更安全、更准确”拆成变量、目标、约束和证据。学习算法前，先手工写出一个小问题，计算一次梯度，做一次有限差分检查，比较一个有约束和一个无约束的结果。这样以后遇到规划、标定或强化学习，才知道算法究竟在替你优化什么。

Optimization is a modeling language. It decomposes “faster, safer, more accurate, and more stable” into variables, objectives, constraints, and evidence. Before learning a new algorithm, write a small problem by hand, check one gradient with finite differences, and compare constrained and unconstrained results. Then, when you meet planning, calibration, or reinforcement learning, you will know what the algorithm is actually optimizing.

最小验收：把“更好”拆成变量、目标和约束；用有限差分检查一个梯度；比较两个初值、一个有约束和一个无约束的结果，并解释目标下降但任务失败的可能原因。 Minimum check: decompose “better” into variables, objectives, and constraints; check one gradient with finite differences; compare two initializations with constrained and unconstrained runs; and explain why a decreasing objective can still produce task failure.
为一个二维末端轨迹写出至少四项代价：终点位姿误差、速度平滑、与障碍物的距离和总时间。给出每项的单位、归一化方式、权重、硬约束和成功阈值，并用两个不同初值运行梯度下降，记录失败模式。
8.7 完整问题卡：从机器人目标到可审计目标函数 8.7 A complete problem card: from a robot goal to an auditable objective
一个可研究的优化问题至少包含五层：决策变量 $z$、可计算的状态映射 $x=f(z)$、分项代价 $c_i$、硬约束 $g_j(z)\leq0$，以及独立于代价的任务验收指标。把这些层混成一个标量会让你无法回答“是代价变好了，还是任务真的变好了”。

A research-grade optimization problem has at least five layers: decision variable $z$, computable state map $x=f(z)$, component costs $c_i$, hard constraints $g_j(z)\leq0$, and task acceptance metrics independent of the cost. Collapsing them into one scalar prevents you from answering whether the cost improved or the task actually improved.

blocks.text: 8.8 可运行的建模语义：尺度、残差与投影 8.8 Executable modeling semantics: scales, residuals, and projection
`weighted_objective` 强制每个分项提供尺度和权重；尺度不是为了让数字“好看”，而是把米、弧度、牛顿和秒放到可比较的无量纲空间。`least_squares_report` 同时报告残差、梯度和 rank；`project_box` 返回投影修改量，说明约束是否正在改变动作。

`weighted_objective` requires a scale and weight for every term; a scale does not make numbers look nice, it places metres, radians, newtons, and seconds in a comparable dimensionless space. `least_squares_report` reports residual, gradient, and rank together; `project_box` returns the intervention, showing whether constraints are modifying the action.

blocks.title: 目标下降不等于任务成功 / Objective decrease is not task success

blocks.text: 如果插入力峰值的权重过小，优化器可以通过更快插入降低总时间，却让峰值力超过安全门；如果姿态误差没有归一化，数值较大的平移项会淹没姿态项；如果把硬约束写成惩罚项，求解器可能接受不可行解。实验必须同时保存 objective、constraint residual 和 task metric。

If insertion-force weight is too small, the optimizer can reduce time by inserting faster while violating the force gate; without orientation scaling, a numerically larger translation term hides orientation; if a hard constraint becomes only a penalty, an infeasible solution may be accepted. Save objective, constraint residual, and task metric together.
8.9 研究出口：优化器替换的公平协议 8.9 Research exit: a fair protocol for replacing optimizers
比较梯度下降、SQP、MPC 或强化学习时，先固定问题卡、数据、初值集合、停止预算和验收指标，再替换求解器。每个方法都要输出相同的分项代价、约束违反量、计算时间、失败原因和随机种子；否则“新方法更好”可能只是换了尺度或分母。

When comparing gradient descent, SQP, MPC, or reinforcement learning, fix the problem card, data, initializations, stopping budget, and acceptance metrics before changing the solver. Every method must output the same component costs, constraint violations, compute time, failure reason, and seed; otherwise “the new method is better” may only mean that the scale or denominator changed.
证据闭环补充：本章对象 Evidence-loop supplement: the chapter object
先修：变量、单位、时间戳、状态和失败分类。任何本章对象都要写成 $x_{t+1}=f(x_t,u_t)$，并声明输入、输出、frame、age 和任务容差；缺少这些字段时，漂亮的曲线不能支撑科研主张。

Prerequisite: variables, units, timestamps, states, and failure taxonomies. Express the chapter object as $x_{t+1}=f(x_t,u_t)$ and declare inputs, outputs, frames, age, and task tolerance; a polished curve cannot support a research claim when these fields are missing.

blocks.code:
def gate(value, tolerance, age, max_age):
    return abs(value) <= tolerance and age <= max_age
assert gate(0.6, 2.0, 0.05, 0.1)
assert not gate(0.6, 2.0, 0.2, 0.1)
